caption: The selected folder has a baseline and one observed completion.
eval:
(async () => {const p = app.plugins.plugins['task-query-undo']; for (const m of [...p.modals]) m.close(); p.pro.signOut(); await p.flush(); await p.clearHistory(); const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Task Query Undo/Tasks/Finance.md'); await app.vault.modify(f, "# Finance review

## Home
- [ ] Pay rent
Rent is due on Friday.

## Work
- [ ] Check invoice
Compare the invoice with the order.

## Weekly review
- [ ] Send report
Read the report before sending it.

## Journal
Keep the later planning notes here.
"); await p.selectFolder('Task Query Undo/Tasks');await app.vault.process(f, text => text.replace('- [ ] Pay rent', '- [x] Pay rent ✅ 2026-10-14')); await p.observe(f);p.showHistory();document.querySelectorAll('.notice').forEach(n => n.remove()); return 'ok';})()
